QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Wind Archer
QuestInfo.0: The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Wind Archer, the Bowman of wind, talk to the #bChief Knight of the Wind #p1101005##k.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to become free-spirited Wind Archer of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101005#.
QuestInfo.2: You are now a Wind Archer!

0.0: Nine hundred ninety-nine... And one thousand. Pardon me, I was just finishing my daily push-ups. So, you wish to be a knight? I am #p1101005#, #bChief Knight of Wind#k and #bleader of the Wind Archers#k.
0.1: Wind Archers are like Bowmen. We shoot arrows at enemies from a distance and #bpossess high DEX to ensure accuracy in our attacks.#k You don't mind if I do crunches while we talk, do you?
0.2: Where was I? Oh yes. Unlike Bowmen, we are aided by #bVentus, the spirit of wind#k, who protects us and enhances our arrows.
0.3: Wind is the symbol of freedom, but freedom without discipline is just self-indulgence, which I don't tolerate. If you think you can balance freedom with restraint, the path of the #bWind Archer#k may be for you. Let me know if it is. In the meantime, I have to get started on my squats.
